purpose: Draws the outer UAE boundary (edges between in-UAE and outside cells) as a dashed blue SVG overlay matching the existing 'UAE Borders' legend.

chunks.ReplacementContent:
</Box>

        {/* UAE Boundary Overlay: outer edge of all in-UAE cells */}
        <svg
          viewBox="0 0 100 100"
          preserveAspectRatio="none"
          aria-hidden="true"
          style={{
            position: "absolute",
            top: 2,
            left: 2,
            width: "calc(100% - 4px)",
            height: "calc(100% - 4px)",
            pointerEvents: "none",
            zIndex: 3,
            overflow: "visible",
          }}
        >
          <path
            d={UAE_MATRIX_BOUNDARY_PATH}
            fill="none"
            stroke="#0000FF"
            strokeWidth={2}
            strokeDasharray="6 4"
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke"
          />
        </svg>
        </Box>

        {/* Legend Row matching Screenshot 1 */}
